description: This Java class defines a DateRange utility that models a date interval with start and end dates, providing a method to parse such ranges from string representations.

classes.name: DateRange
classes.description: Utility class representing a date range with start and end dates, including a method to instantiate it from a string.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a DateRange object by parsing a string that specifies a start and optionally an end date, separated by '..'. If the input string is null, defaults to the current business date.
